testimonials.text: It was a very good class — it taught me to use applications much better. My favourite part was Scratch; it was really interesting. The best AI boot camp I have attended. Thank you!

testimonials.name: Zaynab Zameel
testimonials.text: I found this boot camp to be very interesting! I learned the basics of AI in just 5 days and got to create cool games using Scratch. I also learned how a good prompt can really change the output. Our teacher explained all the topics very well and thoroughly. Thank you!

testimonials.name: Jasma Usman
testimonials.course: Faculty Development Program · Asst. Professor, ISS Arts & Science College
testimonials.text: I would like to thank Famitha Mam and the upNext team for this wonderful 10-day session. These sessions helped me understand clearly and gave me much more confidence. Famitha Mam explained everything in a very simple and understandable way. Thank you!
